author: Inside Edition
description: Another member of TV's Duggar family finds himself being held behind bars Thursday, charged with child molestation. Joseph Duggar, 31 and a married father of three, was taken into custody after a girl, now 14, came forward to claim that in 2020 he molested her on multiple occasions when she was 9. Duggar and his family starred in the hit TLC reality show "19 Kids and Counting." If convicted, he could be joining his older brother, Josh, in prison.
title: TV's Joseph Duggar Accused Of Molesting 9-Year-Old Girl

author: Inside Edition
description: Flyers delayed in seemingly endless lines are learning that if they miss their flight, they are not entitled to a refund. Friends Megan and Camera say they stood in line for five hours in Atlanta and missed their flight to Punta Cana for spring break. The TSA nightmare has entered day 34. In some of the nation's largest airports, like Atlanta, Houston, and New York, a third of the TSA agents have called out sick as they struggle to make ends meet with no paycheck for three weeks.
title: TSA Nightmare Enters Day 34

author: Inside Edition
description: Ever wonder what happened to the kid who played Darth Vader in an iconic Super Bowl commercial in 2011? Max Page was the 6-year-old behind the mask pitching Volkswagen. He is now a college senior studying film at Loyola Marymount University in Los Angeles. The red-headed 6-year-old from the Underwood Deviled Ham commercial in the 1970s is Mason Reese, who is now 60. The 7-year-old twins in the 1976 Shake-N-Bake commercial are Natalie and Jennifer, who are both retired.
title: Where Are The Children From These Iconic Commercials Now?

author: Inside Edition
description: Missing American college student James Gracey on spring break in Barcelona is believed to have been found dead. Gracey is the nephew of a former Republican congressman from Illinois, Peter Roskam. In the wake of Gracey's disappearance, many parents in the US who have children on spring break or studying abroad say they are concerned for their safety. The State Department has issued a level two travel advisory for Spain. Inside Edition spoke with travel expert Katy Nastro.
title: Body Of Missing US College Student Believed To Be Found In Barcelona

author: Inside Edition
description: When snow came to the midwest, the animals at this zoo in Wisconsin had no idea what they were in for. Good thing they had a dedicated human to ride out the storm with them. Wildwood Zoo manager, Kyle Kirk tells WSAW the amount of snow even worried him.  It was up to him to check on the 27 resident species at the zoo. While animals like the bears and lynx fared pretty well, he says other animals were totally confused. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Manager Spends 3 Nights At Zoo To Make Sure The Animals Were Safe

author: Inside Edition
description: It's a new perspective of Paris if you can get through it. Vertigo of the Tower is back at the Eiffel Tower, letting visitors cross from east to west across a bridge nearly 200 feet off the ground. The net encased bridge first debuted a year ago, but judging by the queue to access it, it's back by popular demand. Tourists and locals alike swallowed their fears, risked the vertigo symptoms and took a different walk across the iconic landmark. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Visitors Brave Vertigo Of The Tower At Eiffel Tower For New View Of Paris
